reviewMethod: Reviewed current client definitions and matched route handlers/services. Route-level assertCompanyAccess is tenant scope only. Human-only and operator-only modes are retained only with explicit actor or credential-owner guards; proposal-only requires an actual candidate/draft state and eligible Agent route; direct Agent requires a current handler that accepts Agent actors within a bounded operation. Unproven cases remain unresolved. Additional unresolved rows were reviewed against exact route actor gates and service behavior: a route that calls assertBoardOrAgent, checks an Agent-specific permission/policy, or explicitly admits a scoped Agent is classified DIRECT_AGENT with those conditions in rationale; generic company scope alone remains insufficient. PROPOSAL_ONLY is reserved for routes whose persisted postcondition is a pending review object.
